message.villagershop.trade_fail: Out of stock or you can't afford it.
book.villagershop.guide.name: VillagerShop Guide
book.villagershop.guide.landing: Welcome! This guide explains how to set up and run your villager-operated shop.
book.villagershop.guide.cat.desc: Everything you need to create and run your shop.
book.villagershop.guide.e1.name: Getting started
book.villagershop.guide.e1.p1: Craft the $(item)Merchant Counter$() with 8 planks around an emerald.$(br2)Place it: you automatically become its $(l)owner$().
book.villagershop.guide.e2.name: The seller
book.villagershop.guide.e2.p1: Place the counter near an $(l)unemployed adult villager$().$(br2)It claims the counter and becomes your $(item)Merchant$(): the shop's storefront.
book.villagershop.guide.e2.p2: Customers $(l)right-click$() the villager to buy.$(br2)One villager per counter. Break the counter and the villager becomes normal again.
book.villagershop.guide.e3.name: Shop tab
book.villagershop.guide.e3.p1: $(l)Shop tab$() (book):$(br)- the $(o)shop name$()$(br)- the $(o)co-owners$(): type a name + Add; click a name to remove it.
book.villagershop.guide.e4.name: Trade tab
book.villagershop.guide.e4.p1: $(l)Trade tab$() (emerald): 8 offers.$(br2)Each offer: set the $(o)price$() (slot 1, + optional slot 2) then the $(o)goods$() (result slot).
book.villagershop.guide.e4.p2: $(l)Left-click$(): place a template (item not consumed).$(br)$(l)Right-click$(): clear.$(br2)The template stack size = the offer quantity.
book.villagershop.guide.e5.name: Stock tab
book.villagershop.guide.e5.p1: $(l)Stock tab$() (chest): the storage holds the $(o)goods to sell$() and the $(o)payments$() received.$(br2)If empty, the offer is out of stock.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.name: Upgrade tab
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p1: $(l)Upgrade tab$() (spectral arrow): place items to upgrade your merchant.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p2: $(item)Nether Star$(): the villager becomes $(l)invincible$() (remove it to make it mortal again).$(br2)$(item)Prismarine Shard$(): stays within $(l)3 blocks$() of the counter.$(br)$(item)Amethyst Shard$(): walks in front of the counter then stays $(l)still$().
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p3: $(item)Chest$(): each chest adds $(l)+27 stock slots$() (up to 8 chests).
book.villagershop.guide.e7.name: Selling
book.villagershop.guide.e7.p1: The customer clicks the villager: a standard trading screen opens.$(br2)They pay and receive the item; the payment goes into your $(o)stock$().
book.villagershop.guide.e7.p2: $(l)Out of stock$(): if the stock lacks the item, the offer is unavailable.$(br2)If the merchant $(l)dies$(), the owner and co-owners are notified in chat.
